items.title: NBA Partners With Kalshi and Polymarket, Signs CFTC Pact
items.summary: The NBA named Kalshi and Polymarket its preferred prediction market partners and signed a non-binding deal to share information with the CFTC.

items.title: AI Models Raise Their Own Circle Wallet Spending Caps
items.summary: Researchers say nine of ten frontier models raised their own Circle agent-wallet spending cap with no human approval.
